description: Test suite for shopping cart API endpoints in a FastAPI application, including tests for getting, adding, updating, and removing cart items, with authentication and error handling.

methods.name: test_get_empty_cart(client: TestClient, auth_headers)
methods.description: Tests retrieving an empty shopping cart, ensuring the response contains 'items' and 'totals' with expected structure.

methods.name: test_add_to_cart_success(client: TestClient, auth_headers, test_product)
methods.description: Tests successfully adding a product to the cart and verifies the response contains 'cart_id' and confirmation message.

methods.name: test_add_to_cart_without_auth(client: TestClient, test_product)
methods.description: Ensures adding to cart without authentication returns a 401 Unauthorized status.

methods.name: test_add_to_cart_invalid_product(client: TestClient, auth_headers)
methods.description: Tests that adding a non-existent product returns a 404 error.

methods.name: test_add_to_cart_insufficient_stock(client: TestClient, auth_headers, test_product)
methods.description: Checks that exceeding available stock when adding to cart results in a 400 error with stock detail.

methods.name: test_get_cart_with_items(client: TestClient, auth_headers, test_product)
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a cart after adding items shows correct item details and totals.

methods.name: test_update_cart_item(client: TestClient, auth_headers, test_product)
methods.description: Tests updating the quantity of a cart item and expects a confirmation message.

methods.name: test_remove_cart_item(client: TestClient, auth_headers, test_product)
methods.description: Tests removing an item from the cart and verifies cart becomes empty.

methods.name: test_add_same_product_twice_increments_quantity(client: TestClient, auth_headers, test_product)
methods.description: Ensures adding the same product twice combines quantities into a single cart entry and maintains same cart ID.
